definitions.gloss: to stroke all over; to pet repeatedly; to rub lovingly
definitions.explanation: To run one's hands over something repeatedly. Used for petting an animal or handling a cherished object with care; with a person as the object it usually suggests unwelcome touching.

examples.japanese: ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}した。
examples.english: I petted the cat all over.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嬉|うれ}しそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}して⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The child was happily stroking the dog all over.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しく→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦{革|かわ}→革：19310_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧、⟦うっとり→うっとり：05271_uttori⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}した。
examples.english: I lovingly ran my hands all over my newly purchased leather bag.

notes:
A compound verb from ⟦{撫|な}でる→撫でる：04411_naderu⟧ (to stroke, to pet) + ⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to turn, to move around). Godan verb conjugating as {撫|な}で{回|まわ}さない, {撫|な}で{回|まわ}します, etc. The 〜⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ suffix adds the nuance of doing something thoroughly or all over.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{猫|ねこ}→猫：02237_neko⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to pet a cat all over
- ⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to stroke someone's head repeatedly
- ⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{撫|な}で{回|まわ}す: to run one's hands all over someone's body

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{振|ふ}り{回|まわ}す→振り回す：06051_furimawasu⟧: to swing around
- ⟦{見|み}{回|まわ}す→見回す：05545_mimawasu⟧: to look around
- ⟦{掻|か}き{回|まわ}す→掻き回す：09915_kakimawasu⟧: to stir; to mess up

WATCH OUT:
With another person's body as the object, {撫|な}で{回|まわ}す usually suggests unwanted, groping touching, not affection.
